description: Allows installs and practice scripts to be associated with multiple practice events.

fields.playbooks.practiceEventIds: Optional array of unique scheduleEvents IDs; each referenced event must be a Practice in the same workspace
fields.playbooks.practiceEventId: Legacy optional single Practice event ID; read when practiceEventIds is absent

legacyCompatibility: No bulk data rewrite is required. Existing practiceEventId values continue to be honored when practiceEventIds is absent. An empty practiceEventIds array means unassigned.
lifecycle: Practice events referenced by installs or scripts cannot be deleted, changed to another event type, or unlinked from their last Game Plan until the preparation items are reassigned or deleted.
